stories.title: Houston's Yousef Bustami called up to Palestine's U-17 national team
stories.blurb: The Houston Dynamo Academy player is headed to a pre-camp ahead of the AFC U-17 qualifiers. From MLS NEXT to national-team duty: that's a Yousef on the rise.

stories.title: Yusuf Maart scores his first two goals for Ried in Austrian Cup thriller
stories.blurb: The South Africa midfielder struck twice against LASK in a 3-3 OFB Cup classic before Ried bowed out in extra time. Two goals in one night: that's a Yusuf-ul double.

stories.title: Yousif Kamal wins Bahrain's first-ever ATF youth tennis title
stories.blurb: Kamal won the boys' 14 and Under singles at the ATF Bahrain Championship 6-2, 6-2, a first for a Bahraini player at an Asian Tennis Federation youth event. Game, set and match: the name Yousif is officially on the honours board.

stories.title: Youssef En-Nesyri's 90th-minute free kick gives Al-Ittihad first ACL Elite win
stories.blurb: En-Nesyri curled a 25-yard free kick into the top corner to beat Neftchi Fergana 2-1 in the AFC Champions League Elite. Over the wall and into the net: a set piece of pure Yous-ef-ficiency.

stories.title: Ambassador Youssef Amrani headlines Morocco Days in Miami at FIU
stories.blurb: Morocco's ambassador to the US spoke at Florida International University during the first Morocco Days in Miami, pitching trade, research and a Casablanca-Miami bridge. Building bridges between continents? Classic Youssef diplo-mastery.

stories.title: Youssouf Fofana sets up 95th-minute equaliser as Sevilla draw 3-3 with Levante
stories.blurb: Fofana teed up Isaac Romero deep in stoppage time to rescue a point for Sevilla. Leaving it to the 95th minute? That's what we call a Yous-sauf save.

stories.title: Youssef Jouad and Youssef Bensalam win top awards as Morocco claim Futsal AFCON
stories.blurb: Morocco beat Angola 5-2 for a fourth straight Futsal AFCON title, with Youssef Jouad named Best Player and Youssef Bensalam Best Goalkeeper. A Youssef scoring at one end and a Youssef saving at the other: the Double Youssef defence is airtight.

stories.title: Ramy Youssef to write, direct and star in A24 comedy 'Martha & Muhammad'
stories.blurb: Amanda Seyfried and Sharon Stone join the cast of Ramy Youssef's feature directorial debut for A24. A Youssef calling all the shots? That's what we call a director's Yousef.

stories.title: Youssef En-Nesyri scores twice as Al-Ittihad beat Al-Ettifaq 4-1
stories.blurb: The Moroccan striker struck a double in round ten of the Saudi Pro League to lift Al-Ittihad back into the top four. When a Youssef finds the net twice, that's just a Yous-ful brace.

stories.title: Brand Lounge appoints Yousef Tuqan as Chief Growth Officer
stories.blurb: The independent brand consultancy hired the former Flip Media CEO to grow its partnerships as it nears its 20th year. Chief Growth Officer is a fitting title, since there's always room to grow-sef.

stories.title: Yusuf Ali makes a Top 100 list of influential assistant coaches
stories.blurb: The West Virginia men's basketball assistant, a Toronto native, landed on a national list after a 21-win first season that ended with a tournament title in Las Vegas. Yousef-adjacent spelling, Yousef-level results.

stories.title: Yusuf / Cat Stevens reissues a remastered 1974 classic
stories.blurb: Buddha and the Chocolate Box came back newly remastered this fall. The most famous Yusuf in music history continues to refuse to slow down.

stories.title: Dhafer Youssef tours Europe's jazz stages
stories.blurb: The Tunisian oud player and vocalist played France and Switzerland in mid-October. Two S's, zero wrong notes.

stories.title: Maine lawmaker achieves the rare Double Yusuf
stories.blurb: State Rep. Yusuf Yusuf, born in Mogadishu, represents District 118 in Portland. Having the name twice is, per our analysts, objectively the strongest possible position.
